conn = sqlite3.connect(get_world_db())

    # Sanitize dates: map 'active' -> 'available', remove unknown cabin keys
    clean_dates = {}
    valid_statuses = {'available', 'on time', 'delayed', 'flying', 'landed', 'cancelled'}

    for date_key, date_val in dates_raw.items():

        if status not in valid_statuses:
            status = "available"

        if status == "available":
            # Clean prices and seats - keep only valid cabin keys
            prices = {k: v for k, v in date_val.get("prices", {}).items() if k in valid_cabins}
            seats = {k: v for k, v in date_val.get("available_seats", {}).items() if k in valid_cabins}
            clean_date["prices"] = prices
            clean_date["available_seats"] = seats
        elif status == "landed":
            clean_date["actual_departure_time_est"] = date_val.get("actual_departure_time_est", "")
            clean_date["actual_arrival_time_est"] = date_val.get("actual_arrival_time_est", "")
        elif status == "delayed":
            clean_date["estimated_departure_time_est"] = date_val.get("estimated_departure_time_est", "")
            clean_date["estimated_arrival_time_est"] = date_val.get("estimated_arrival_time_est", "")
        elif status == "flying":
            clean_date["actual_departure_time_est"] = date_val.get("actual_departure_time_est", "")
            clean_date["estimated_arrival_time_est"] = date_val.get("estimated_arrival_time_est", "")
        elif status == "on time":
            clean_date["estimated_departure_time_est"] = date_val.get("estimated_departure_time_est", "")
            clean_date["estimated_arrival_time_est"] = date_val.get("estimated_arrival_time_est", "")
        elif status == "cancelled":
            pass  # no extra fields needed
        clean_dates[date_key] = clean_date

    flights[r["flight_id"]] = {
        "flight_number": r["flight_id"],
        "origin": r["origin"],
        "destination": r["destination"],
        "scheduled_departure_time_est": r["departure_time"] or "00:00:00",
        "scheduled_arrival_time_est": r["arrival_time"] or "00:00:00",
        "dates": clean_dates,
    }

# 2. Load reservations
_TAU2_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy"}
_TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES = {"one_way", "round_trip"}
resv_by_user = {}
reservations = {}
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM flight_bookings WHERE source_skill=?", (SOURCE_SKILL,)):
    res_flights = []
    for fj in json.loads(r["flights_json"] or "[]"):
        res_flights.append({
            "flight_number": fj.get("flight_number") or fj.get("flight_id"),
            "origin": fj.get("origin", ""),
            "destination": fj.get("destination", ""),
            "date": fj.get("date", ""),
            "price": fj.get("price", 0),
        })
    # Clean passengers - ensure dob exists, remove extra fields
    passengers = []
    for p in json.loads(r["passengers_json"] or "[]"):
        passengers.append({
            "first_name": p.get("first_name", ""),
            "last_name": p.get("last_name", ""),
            "dob": p.get("dob") or p.get("date_of_birth") or "1990-01-01",
        })
    reservations[r["booking_id"]] = {
        "reservation_id": r["booking_id"],
        "user_id": r["user_id"],
        "origin": r["origin"],
        "destination": r["destination"],
        "flight_type": r["flight_type"] if r["flight_type"] in _TAU2_FLIGHT_TYPES else "one_way",
        "cabin": r["cabin_class"] if r["cabin_class"] in _TAU2_CABINS else "economy",
        "flights": res_flights,
        "passengers": passengers,
        "payment_history": json.loads(r["payment_history_json"] or "[]"),
        "created_at": r["booked_at"],
        "total_baggages": r["total_baggages"],
        "nonfree_baggages": r["nonfree_baggages"],
        "insurance": r["add_insurance"] if r["add_insurance"] in ("yes", "no") else "no",
        "status": "cancelled" if r["status"] == "cancelled" else None,
    }
    resv_by_user.setdefault(r["user_id"], []).append(r["booking_id"])

# 3. Load users
_TIER_TO_MEMBERSHIP = {"standard": "regular"}
users = {}
for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE skill_ids_json LIKE ?", (f'%"{SOURCE_SKILL}"%',)):
    parts = (r["name"] or "").split(" ", 1)
